title: 年世纪换算
problem_statement_md: 编写函数`calcCent`，参数为年份，如1993，返回该年对应的世纪如20。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The Math Object[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Create a function that returns the century depending on the year given as a parameter.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
1993

[b]Sample Output[/b]
20

[b]Hint[/b]
You need to divide 1993 by 100: 1993/100 = 19.93, then round it to the nearest integer, which is 20 in this case.

[note]Use [b]Math.ceil(x)[/b] method, which returns x rounded upwards to the nearest integer.[/note]
hint_md: 使用`Math.ceil(x)`方法返回大于等于参数`x`的最小整数，即对浮点数向上取整。
